name: Afghanistan (Republic, 1973–1974)
description: Three vertical stripes of black, red and green with a white emblem on the red stripe: a mosque within wheat sheaves, with two flags and a scroll bearing the name of the country.
history: First flag of the Republic of Afghanistan proclaimed after the coup of 17 July 1973, in which Mohammed Daoud Khan overthrew his cousin King Zahir Shah: the royal tricolour was kept but the emblem lost its crown. It was replaced on 9 May 1974 by the republic's own black, red and green flag with a large eagle emblem.
